messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: whose models to test?
parts:
Does anyone have an opinion as to which models
we should test? The JAGS recoding doesn't quite
match the WinBUGS models.

I'm looking at the most recent WinBUGS and
most recent JAGS coding of the Salmonella
example (aka "salm").

There are slightly different prior constants
in JAGS, as in dnorm(0,1E3) and dnorm(0,1E2)
expressed in terms of deviation.

And also the fact that JAGS centers (but does
not variance normalize) the predictors.

- Bob
